title: Claim status management & Retention date
walkthroughSteps: Apply an AC: it seeds blockers or retention state on CLM-2024-001

walkthroughSteps.title: Close Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: Always clickable: it's only disabled during the brief loading check, never because of blockers. Payments, litigation, bills, or open sections show up as blocker cards inside the modal instead of a disabled-button tooltip.

walkthroughSteps.title: Closure reason
walkthroughSteps.body: Required before the claim can close. Two reasons available (Claim Finalised / Claim Not Pursued; rejection has its own Reject Claim action). If the proximate loss cause is 'Other', a warning appears above this step, but it doesn't block submission.

walkthroughSteps.title: Document retention
walkthroughSteps.body: Three options: Default (computed 10-year date), Custom, or Indefinite (stores no date).

walkthroughSteps.title: Custom retention date
walkthroughSteps.body: Only shown when Custom is selected. It must be strictly after the default 10-year date, enforced live (not just on submit).

walkthroughSteps: Confirm → status chip updates to 'Closed'; closure panel shows date, reason, closed-by, and retention until (or 'Indefinite')

walkthroughSteps.title: Reopen Claim
walkthroughSteps.body: Visible once the claim is Closed.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens a modal for a reopening reason (no note field), then a section selection step and a confirm step. No reserve is captured: the Reserve team is told through the claim-updated event (BMPCC-14607). Confirming sets the status to Open, shows Reopened date and Reopening reason, and hides Closure date and Closure reason.

walkthroughSteps.title: Reopening reason
walkthroughSteps.body: The only claim-level input. There is no reserve field: BMPCC-14607 (Re-Open functional spec) puts reserve capture out of scope and tells the Reserve team through the claim-updated event.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Close Claim action is on Claim Overview; handler must select a closure reason
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: **Close Claim** action is *accessible on the Claim Overview page*. Handler must select one of two reasons (`Claim Finalised` / `Claim Not Pursued`) before the claim can be closed. Rejecting a claim is a separate action (**Reject Claim**, BMPCC-17630), not a closure reason here.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Closure blocked when payments / recoveries / litigation / provider / bills / reports are outstanding
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: Closure is **blocked** when *any* of the listed activities are outstanding. The blocker tooltip lists which activity needs resolution. (BMPCC-11360 AC2: activity flags driven by mock claim data.)

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Retention date defaults to 10 years; handler can override to Custom or Indefinite
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: On step 3 of the closure modal, three retention options are available: **Default (10 years)**, **Custom** (must extend beyond default), and **Indefinite**. Default is auto-applied; Custom unlocks a date picker pinned to ≥ default + 10y; Indefinite stores no date.

'Indefinite' radio stores no date

howToTest.expectedResult: Retention options visible; Custom unlocks calendar

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Closed claim shows closure date and retention info on the file
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: After closure, the **claim file** shows: `Closure date`, `Closure reason`, and `Retention until` (Indefinite or formatted date). All read-only. `Closed by` is not shown: it is the same person as the claim handler. Once the claim is reopened, Closure date and Closure reason are hidden (spec 3055659701), see AC-07.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Reopen asks for a reason, no reserve is captured; the reopening date is visible and the closure fields are hidden
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: A `Closed` claim can be **reopened** with a reason and a section selection. No reserve type or amount is captured (BMPCC-14607: the Reserve team is notified by event only; this replaces the earlier reserve rule). After reopen, the **Reopened date** and **Reopening reason** are visible on the file and Closure date and Closure reason are hidden (spec 3055659701). **NOTE:** the status chip reads `Open`; this story and the spec both say `Reopened`, so this AC stays partial until the status label is decided.
